sentences.en: The safeguard of the state shall be the supreme law.
sentences.zh: 国家的保护措施应当是至高无上的法律。

sentences.en: Free flow of information is the only safeguard against tyranny.
sentences.zh: 信息的自由流通是防止暴政的唯一保障。

sentences.en: They have improved safeguards and they are now better prepared than before.
sentences.zh: 他们已经改进了保护措施，现在比以前更有准备。

senses.zh: [安全] 保护；保卫；保护措施

mnemonic: 词根记忆：safe（安全）+guard（保卫）→保卫
